structuralNote: Bu dosya tek bir vize turu DEGIL - doktor mesleginin Express Entry, PNP, Atlantic Immigration, Rural/Francophone pilotlari uzerine bindirilen meslek-ozel kurallari (immigrationPathways) + gocten tamamen ayri, paralel bir tibbi lisanslama sureci (medicalLicensingPathway) iceriyor. Bir doktorun Kanada'da pratik yapabilmesi icin HER IKISI de gerekiyor - gocmenlik statusu kazanmak, lisans almak icin yeterli degil.
newFor2026: Express Entry category-based selection round specifically for physicians with 1+ year full-time Canadian MD work experience in the last 3 years
5,000 federal immigration spaces reserved through PNP to nominate physicians with a job offer or letter of support
PNP-nominated physicians get expedited work permit processing within 14 days

hasCanadianMDExperience.description: At least 1 year full-time MD work experience in Canada within the last 3 years

noCanadianMDExperienceYet.description: Internationally-trained, no Canadian clinical MD experience yet (or Canadian experience is older than 3 years)
noCanadianMDExperienceYet.prerequisite: Must still get foreign credentials assessed and licensed by a provincial/territorial regulatory authority

immigrationPathways.name: Express Entry - Physician Category (New 2026)
eligibility: Eligible for 1 of the 3 Express Entry programs (CEC/FSW/FSTP)
At least 1 year full-time Canadian MD work experience in the last 3 years
processSteps: Create/update Express Entry profile, submit to pool
Wait for invitation (extend existing work permit if in Canada; apply for work permit with job offer if outside Canada)
Apply for PR within 60 days of invitation

immigrationPathways.name: Provincial Nominee Program (physician-reserved spaces)
eligibility: Has a job, job offer, or letter of support to work as MD in a province/territory
processSteps: Select province/territory and get nominated under their physician stream
Apply for PR via Express Entry process or non-Express Entry process (whichever the province's stream uses)
Work while application processes, using expedited 14-day work permit once nominated
immigrationPathways.note: Quebec and Nunavut excluded - consistent with general PNP finding (no PNP program in either).

immigrationPathways.name: Atlantic Immigration Program (AIP)
eligibility: Work experience OR post-secondary education completed in Atlantic Canada
Job offer from a designated employer
Interested in living in Atlantic Canada

immigrationPathways.name: Rural Community Immigration Pilot (RCIP)
eligibility: 1+ year MD work experience in last 3 years, OR graduated from an eligible post-secondary school
Job offer from a designated employer
Interested in living in a smaller, rural community

immigrationPathways.name: Francophone Community Immigration Pilot (FCIP)
eligibility: 1+ year MD work experience in last 3 years, OR graduated from an eligible post-secondary school
Job offer from a designated employer
Interested in living in a Francophone community outside Quebec

medicalLicensingPathway.note: Bu surec IRCC/gocmenlik degil - Medical Council of Canada (MCC) ve eyalet/bolge Medical Regulatory Authority'leri (MRA) tarafindan yonetiliyor. Gocmenlik statusunden BAGIMSIZ olarak tamamlanmasi gerekiyor.

components.I: Immigration - valid status (work permit/PR/citizenship) required for CaRMS and some PRA routes
components.M: Medical licensing - physiciansapply.ca account, MCCQE, NAC Exam, provincial/territorial pathway
components.G: Gap or currency of practice - prolonged interruption makes eligibility harder; full-time med school/accredited residency/accredited internship/clinical fellowship with patient care generally NOT considered a gap; clinical research without active license, volunteer roles, medical assistant roles ARE considered gaps

centralPortal.name: physiciansapply.ca
funding: Federation of Medical Regulatory Authorities of Canada and members
services: Apply for MCCQE and NAC Examination
View/share documents and exam results (File Transfer Service for non-registered orgs)
Request ECA report (needed for e.g. Federal Skilled Worker Program)
Apply for medical registration with MRAs
centralPortal.specialNote: Candidates targeting Ontario should contact the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario directly for source verification, not MCC.

MCCQE.fullName: Medical Council of Canada Qualifying Examination
MCCQE.format: One-day, computer-based, 230 MCQs in 2 sections of 115 items, up to 2h40m per section
MCCQE.deliveredIn: Canada + 70+ countries, 4 sessions/year, Prometric test centres, first-come-first-served
eligibility: Graduate of a CACMS-accredited medical school
OR graduate of a school listed in World Directory of Medical Schools with a Canada Sponsor Note
OR graduate of a AOA-accredited US School of Osteopathic Medicine

attemptLimit.rule: After 3rd attempt, must wait 1 year before 4th attempt (non-negotiable). Pre-2018 attempts don't count. 'No Standing' doesn't count as attempt; fail or 'Denied Standing' do count. Cannot retake after a pass.
attemptLimit.eligibilityWindow: 12 months to schedule/write after application acceptance

MCCQE.studentApplicationWindow: Up to 15 months before expected graduation date; eligibility window begins 12 months before expected graduation

NAC.purpose: Assesses IMG readiness to enter supervised training in Canada; required for CaRMS entry and as screening tool for some provincial PRA programs
NAC.orderFlexibility: Can be taken before or after MCCQE, candidate's choice (for 2027 CaRMS R-1 applicants)

licensurePathwayOptions.name: CaRMS Match
licensurePathwayOptions.description: For IMGs without postgraduate training, or with postgraduate training completed outside Canada who are willing to retrain. Apply to/match with/complete a Canadian residency program via CaRMS.

licensurePathwayOptions.name: Practice-Ready Assessment (PRA) Programs
licensurePathwayOptions.description: For IMGs who completed residency and practised independently abroad. 12-week clinical workplace-based assessment.

licensurePathwayOptions.name: Approved Jurisdictions
licensurePathwayOptions.description: For IMGs from jurisdictions deemed substantially equivalent to Canadian training, per CFPC/RCPSC/CMQ criteria.

licensurePathwayOptions.name: Practice Eligibility Route (PER)
licensurePathwayOptions.description: For IMGs who completed postgraduate training outside Canada in a recognized primary specialty.

postLicensureSteps: Apply for LMCC (Licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada) - part of the Canadian Standard
Apply for specialty certificate with RCPSC, CFPC, or CMQ
Apply for medical registration with the MRA of the province/territory of intended practice (via physiciansapply.ca for most MRAs)
regulatoryAuthorities: College of Physicians & Surgeons of Alberta
College of Physicians and Surgeons of British Columbia
College of Physicians and Surgeons of Manitoba
College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick
College of Physicians and Surgeons of Newfoundland & Labrador
College of Physicians & Surgeons of Nova Scotia
College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario
College of Physicians & Surgeons of Prince Edward Island
College of Physicians and Surgeons of Saskatchewan

languageRequirements.generalRule: English required in most provinces; New Brunswick accepts English OR French; Quebec requires French

englishTests.IELTS_Academic: Minimum 7.0 in each of 4 components, single sitting
englishTests.OET_Medicine: Minimum grade B in each subset, single sitting
englishTests.CELPIP_General: Minimum score 9 in each component, single sitting

languageRequirements.frenchTestQuebec: Pass result on OQLF (Office quebecois de la langue francaise) examination
languageRequirements.validityWindow: Test result must be within 24 months of application to provincial/territorial program
languageRequirements.possibleExemption: If undergraduate/postgraduate training completed in an English- or French-speaking country, or majority of education/patient care was in English/French - exemption decided per program

keyDeadlineExample.requirement: Submit MCCQE application + required documents by this date to obtain Identity Validity Period (IVP) before file review opens 2026-11-26

foreignCredentialRecognition.note: General program, not physician-specific - relevant prerequisite for any regulated occupation/compulsory trade, mentioned in this source as applicable to physicians too.
foreignCredentialRecognition.process: Verifies foreign education/training/experience equivalence to Canadian standards for the profession/trade in the province/territory of intended practice; varies by occupation and jurisdiction.
foreignCredentialRecognition.tool: Foreign Credential Recognition Tool - checks if an occupation is regulated/compulsory in a given province/territory and finds the relevant regulatory authority.

loans.purpose: Licensing/qualifying exam fees, education/training programs, related costs

otherNewcomerServices: Pre-arrival services (for approved PR applicants still outside Canada)

otherHealthcareWorkers.note: Non-physician healthcare workers may be eligible for different programs; Express Entry continues to invite candidates with other healthcare work experience via general/program-specific rounds (not the new physician-specific category).
